scripts.dev: concurrently -n bridge,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter bridge dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter bridge test && pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @jericho/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter bridge typecheck
scripts.electron:build: pnpm build && pnpm electron:compile && electron-builder --config electron/electron-builder.yml --publish always
scripts.electron:build:local: pnpm build && pnpm electron:compile && electron-builder --config electron/electron-builder.yml --publish never
